tasks.title: Document the final-review comment and maintainer merge workflow
tasks.brief:
**Goal:** Make the agreed final-review gate clear for Orbit task PRs.

**Contract:** docs/reference/implementation-loop.md#final-review-of-an-orbit-task-pull-request and #the-maintainer-approves-every-merge; docs/contributor-guide.md#review-and-merge; docs/reference/tasks.md#settling.

**Builds on:** None. Start from the prepared contract on task-677.

**Deliverables:**
- Feature delivery describes a final comment for the exact head, checks/evidence/limitations/verdict, delegated authorization, successful Required checks on that head, immediate merge through the maintainer profile with --match-head-commit, re-review after head changes, and scheduler completion.
- Tasks and contributor pages link to the owning workflow and distinguish generic engine subtask approval from final whole-PR review.
- Rationale and limits state that the admin profile bypasses GitHub enforcement. Formal approving review is optional; the App merge endpoint and ruleset change are deferred.
- Full deterministic impact evidence covers every planned path in .loop/planned-paths.json.
- Documentation generation and lint pass; commit any generated context changes.

**Acceptance:** Review the prepared pages against the 2026-10-01 group decision; finish any missing documentation before handoff. Run the planned-path impact command and composer docs-build and composer docs-lint. Run npx mint validate and npx mint broken-links from docs for the changed links, recording any existing unrelated failure. No product code, live GitHub policy change, PR comment, or merge is part of this subtask.

tasks.title: Require formal GitHub approval in the final-review documentation
tasks.brief:
**Goal:** Replace the comment-only gate with a formal GitHub approval for the reviewed PR head, as the maintainer approved on 2026-10-01.

**Contract:** docs/reference/implementation-loop.md#final-review-of-an-orbit-task-pull-request and #the-maintainer-approves-every-merge; docs/contributor-guide.md#review-and-merge; docs/reference/tasks.md#settling. This scope correction supersedes optional-approval wording in the historical group and ORB-678 briefs.

**Builds on:** ORB-678. Preserve its in-flight work. The prepared correction is on origin/plan/task-677-formal-review; inspect its delta from 117aa26196ede32950456ce6dd7d20cb7e9d1459 and apply only the relevant documentation changes, preserving any intervening task work. Do not reset the active workspace or change the group branch.

**Deliverables:**
- Final whole-PR review is a formal GitHub review from the designated final reviewer under the maintainer profile. Its body records full reviewed SHA, verification/results, limitations, evidence, and verdict. Submit the reviews API event APPROVE with commit_id bound to that SHA; the PR author cannot approve their own PR.
- Merge guidance requires GitHub review records confirming identity, APPROVED state, and current-head commit_id. A comment alone, dismissed approval, approval for another head, outstanding requested changes from the final reviewer, or unreadable review data prevents merge.
- Successful Required checks on the same reviewed head, complete required verification, resolved findings, authorization, and gh pr merge --merge --match-head-commit remain required. A new head requires renewed review and formal approval.
- Explain that final DevOps review/configuration remains external, maintainer-profile admin bypass remains, and no ruleset/App merge endpoint or automatic review-feedback handling ships here.
- Documentation generation, lint, and the existing complete planned-path impact evidence pass.

**Acceptance:** Inspect current pages for conflicting optional-approval/comment-only wording and correct it. Run composer docs-build and composer docs-lint, the planned-path impact check, and Mint validation/broken-link checks for changed links. Keep all work documentation-only; do not post a live GitHub review, merge a PR, change a ruleset, or implement the feedback watcher as a proof.

tasks.title: Apply and verify the formal GitHub approval and merge guidance
tasks.brief:
**Goal:** The DevOps reviewer applies the formal GitHub approval gate and merges the reviewed commit through the maintainer's GitHub CLI profile.

**Contract:** docs/reference/implementation-loop.md#final-review-of-an-orbit-task-pull-request; .agents/skills/reviewing-pull-requests/SKILL.md and .agents/skills/merging-pull-requests/SKILL.md. The formal-approval decision supersedes optional-approval/comment-only wording in the historical group brief.

**Builds on:** ORB-678 and ORB-732's corrected, reviewed documentation contract.

**Deliverables:**
- Final review skill submits a formal GitHub review only when authorized. The body records full reviewed SHA, whole-PR assessment, evidence/results/limitations, and verdict. Submit event APPROVE with commit_id set to the reviewed head using the reviews API through the maintainer profile; use REQUEST_CHANGES for blocking findings.
- Merge skill reads GitHub review records and verifies designated reviewer identity, APPROVED state, and commit_id matching the current head. A plain comment, dismissed approval, stale approval, outstanding requested changes from the final reviewer, or unreadable review data prevents merge.
- Require successful Required checks on that same head, resolved findings, complete required verification, and scoped authorization. Re-read the head and merge through gh pr merge --merge --match-head-commit; any new head requires renewed review and approval. No formal review by the PR author.
- .loop/merge-workflow-proof.md walks through allowed and refused cases: approved current head plus green CI; plain ready-to-merge comment only; approval for another head; dismissal; requested changes; missing or unreadable reviews; wrong reviewer; pending/failed/missing/unreadable checks; incomplete required review; missing authorization; unresolved findings; known main correctness failure. Label this as a walkthrough, not a proved live merge.
- Read-only gh help/repository observations verify installed CLI flags and current bypass/auto-merge settings. Finish the prepared skills while preserving task work; inspect origin/plan/task-677-formal-review only as a proposal, not a replacement for the workspace.

**Acceptance:** Run git diff --check and composer docs-lint; inspect gh pr merge --help. Verify walkthroughs against both skills and the corrected docs. No product/API/SDK/MCP code, policy/App permissions, automatic feedback watcher, live review, or live merge demonstration is in scope. External DevOps configuration remains outside this group. Record current bypass as a workflow limitation. Preserve the separate main-workspace orbit-tasks edit. Complete the focused task PR through the existing publisher; independent review still applies.

Diff and docs checks pass; installed gh exposes the documented merge command flags
